raw_response:
My land is 9 mu total. Cotton is my main crop — I grow it every year on most of my land because that is what works here in Quzhou. I will put 6 mu to cotton, 2 mu to maize, and 1 mu to mungbean for the family and some to sell.

For cotton, I buy hybrid Bt seed from the dealer in town — everyone around me uses it because the bollworm problem is too bad without it. I apply about 2 bags of compound fertilizer (15-15-15) per mu before planting, that is 50 kg, then top-dress with urea about 15 kg when the bolls start forming. My neighbor Old Wang always does similar and gets good cotton. Cotton needs water — I irrigate from the well 4 times: after planting, budding, flowering, boll-opening. Pests are the worst part — I spray maybe 6 times for aphids, mites, bollworm. Last year I got around 260 jin of seed cotton per mu, I hope for the same or a little more.

For maize, I use hybrid seed (Zhengdan or similar, whatever the shop recommends). I put one bag of compound fertilizer plus urea topdress at big-trumpet stage. Two irrigations usually. Maize is easier than cotton, less spraying. I expect 500 kg per mu, that is normal here.

Mungbean I plant on 1 mu, mostly for home eating and selling a little. It does not need much fertilizer — the plant fixes its own nitrogen, my father always said. A little compound at planting is enough. One irrigation if the rain is short. Expect maybe 120 kg per mu.

Tillage — I rent the rotary tiller from the village machine group, everyone does this now, plowing deep is too much work for 9 mu.

Money is tight with 4 people and only some off-farm income. I cannot afford to be fancy, but I also cannot risk a bad harvest. So I do what worked last year and what my neighbors do.
